:::{#def-matrix-order}
#### Order of a square matrix

The **order** of a square matrix (@def-square-matrix)
is its number of rows, which equals its number of columns.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-matrix-order}
#### Orders of square matrices

$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$ has order $2$,
and $[5]$ has order $1$.
A $2 \times 3$ matrix has no order, since it is not square (@exm-square-matrix).

:::
